name: Space Race Begins
description: Competition between the Soviet Union and the United States to explore outer space.

name: Launch of Sputnik 1
description: The Soviet Union successfully launches the world's first artificial satellite, initiating the Space Age.

name: Launch of Explorer 1
description: The United States successfully launches its first satellite in response to the Sputnik launch.

name: Yuri Gagarin becomes the First Human in Space
description: Soviet cosmonaut Yuri Gagarin completes one orbit around the Earth aboard Vostok 1, becoming the first human in space.

name: Alan Shepard becomes the First American in Space
description: American astronaut Alan Shepard completes a suborbital spaceflight aboard Freedom 7, becoming the first American in space.

name: John F. Kennedy's Moon Speech
description: President John F. Kennedy delivers a speech committing the United States to landing a man on the Moon before the end of the decade.

name: Valentina Tereshkova becomes the First Woman in Space
description: Soviet cosmonaut Valentina Tereshkova becomes the first woman to travel to space aboard Vostok 6.

name: Launch of Voskhod 1
description: The Soviet Union launches the Voskhod 1 spacecraft, carrying a crew of three and becoming the first mission to have multiple astronauts on board.

name: Gemini 3: First Manned Gemini Mission
description: NASA's Gemini 3 spacecraft, piloted by Gus Grissom and John Young, performs three orbits of the Earth.

name: Launch of Soyuz 1
description: The Soviet Union launches Soyuz 1 with cosmonaut Vladimir Komarov aboard, but the mission ends in tragedy with Komarov's death during re-entry.

name: Apollo 8: First Manned Mission to the Moon
description: NASA's Apollo 8 mission, commanded by Frank Borman, becomes the first manned spacecraft to orbit the Moon.

name: Apollo 11: First Moon Landing
description: NASA's Apollo 11 mission, commanded by Neil Armstrong, successfully lands the first humans on the Moon.

name: Launch of Salyut 1
description: The Soviet Union launches Salyut 1, the world's first space station.

name: Apollo-Soyuz Test Project
description: The United States and the Soviet Union conduct a joint space mission, docking an Apollo spacecraft with a Soyuz spacecraft in orbit.

name: Voyager 1 Launch
description: NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft is launched, later becoming the first human-made object to reach interstellar space.

name: Launch of Space Shuttle Columbia
description: NASA's Space Shuttle Columbia becomes the first operational space shuttle, beginning the era of reusable spacecraft.

name: Mir Space Station Launch
description: Soviet Union launches Mir, a modular space station that becomes the focus of long-duration human spaceflight for over a decade.

name: Hubble Space Telescope Launch
description: NASA's Hubble Space Telescope is launched, revolutionizing our understanding of the universe.

name: International Space Station (ISS) Begins Assembly
description: Construction of the International Space Station begins with the launch of the Russian Zarya module.

name: SpaceShipOne's First Spaceflight
description: SpaceShipOne, a privately-funded spacecraft, becomes the first non-governmental crewed vehicle to reach space.

name: New Horizons' Pluto Flyby
description: NASA's New Horizons spacecraft conducts a flyby of Pluto, providing the first close-up images of the dwarf planet.

name: Crew Dragon Demo-2: First Crewed SpaceX Mission
description: NASA's Crew Dragon spacecraft, developed by SpaceX, launches astronauts Bob Behnken and Doug Hurley to the International Space Station.

name: Artemis Program: NASA's Return to the Moon
description: NASA announces the Artemis program, aiming to land the first woman and the next man on the Moon by 2024.

name: Perseverance Rover Landing on Mars
description: NASA's Perseverance rover successfully lands on Mars to search for signs of ancient microbial life and collect samples for return to Earth.
